Quick Start

  1. Connect the keyboard first (close VIA if running).
  2. Draw frames with the brush / eraser / fill tools (or use Import PNG(s) / Import GIF / Import File to load existing material).
  3. The animation plays on the Pad matrix at 60fps. Click Upload to Keyboard, and it starts playing automatically when done.
  4. If the matrix does not show the animation, select mode "31 Frame Animation" in Matrix Effects → Pad Panel → Mode.
  5. To share your work: Save to Library first, then Export File and send the .json to friends. They can Import File to load it.

Piskel (optional external editor)

Piskel has an English-only UI with no language option. First-time setup (once): Settings → Resize → Default Size: width 13, height 13. Piskel remembers it, so new piskels open as 13x13. Draw, export GIF, then click Import GIF here.

Flash Firmware (DFU)

  1. Put the keyboard into DFU mode: hold Esc BEFORE plugging in the USB cable, keep holding while inserting, then release.
  2. Click Connect and pick the "STM32 BOOTLOADER" device in the dialog.
  3. Choose the latest firmware you downloaded after updating on the main page, then click the Flash Firmware button to flash. All settings and animations will be reset. If you have important animations to keep, save your config on the main page first.
Windows driver needed (WinUSB)

On Windows, WebUSB needs the STM32 DFU device bound to the WinUSB driver. If Connect finds no device, download the driver package below (ST official signed driver — no Zadig needed), unzip and double-click the install script, then click Connect again.
